# A component the program declares as a primitive has no body by design.
#
# Lowering drops a bodyless component when building for a target, because one
# that declares nothing renders nothing and every platform used to guess
# differently at what an empty component meant. A member of a segmented tree is
# the exception: passCanvas emits it, so dropping it takes the canvas contents
# with it.
#
# The signals are the whole list -- #[intrinsic], #[builtin], a wildcard
# pattern, a tree -- but only a tree is reachable from user code, so it is what
# this asserts: `blip` is one because it names `draw.shape` in its return
# position. Without the exemption the canvas emits no draw calls at all and
# still exits 0.

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=out main.sngl
exists out/index.html

# The canvas renders, and the marked shape inside it reached passCanvas.
grep 'ctx\.save\(\)' out/index.html
grep 'ctx\.restore\(\)' out/index.html

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import "sngl:ui/draw"
component blip(x float, y float) draw.shape {}

component main() {
    window(title="t") {
        draw.canvas(width=100px, height=100px) {
            blip(x=1.0, y=2.0)
        }
    }
}
